source: Authenticated Rakuten Advertising private-offer notification delivered to the verified DealDesk operations mailbox, official Rakuten private-offer help documentation, and Giftcards.com's live U.S. promotions, product, FAQ, and legal pages

relationship.finding: Rakuten's official help documentation says advertisers may extend private offers to existing partners or use them to recruit a new partnership. The email alone therefore does not prove that DealDesk is Partnered, that the offer is assigned, or that a payable link is authorized.

tracking.requirement: Confirm Partnered status and the currently assigned offer in the signed-in Rakuten dashboard, then generate and verify an exact DealDesk link, advertiser ID, offer ID, link ID, destination, attribution, product eligibility, and confidential program restrictions before publication.

candidates.name: ECO5 Visa Thank You Gift Card promotion
candidates.customerValue: 5% off a 100 USD physical Visa Thank You Gift Card
candidates.publicConditions: One-time code; up to three qualifying cards per purchase and customer; no stacking; while supplies last; Giftcards.com may end the promotion early. The 100 USD tier publicly lists a 4.95 USD product fee and 1.99 USD USPS Standard shipping per card before any applicable tax.
candidates.verificationConflict: The promotions page advertises ECO5 while the product page reports that no promotions are available for the card. Code acceptance and the resulting cart total are not verified.

candidates.name: Physical One4all free USPS Standard shipping
candidates.customerValue: The public promotion waives the normal USPS Standard shipping charge on up to three eligible physical One4all gift cards
candidates.publicConditions: No code is stated. Paid expedited shipping remains separate. Eligibility is limited to qualifying physical One4all cards and must be checked card by card.

publicOfferResearch.materialTerms: Gift-card value, activation or product fees, shipping charges, taxes, redemption restrictions, inactivity and replacement fees, cancellation timing, final-sale terms, availability, eligible card brands, and exact checkout behavior must be verified for each future listing.

publication.reason: The private-offer email does not establish an accepted or currently assigned relationship, no exact payable Rakuten link is verified, and the strongest public promotion has a product-page conflict.

privacy: No confidential commission tiers, private offer name, private offer dates, raw email body, passwords, cookies, payment data, tax data, session tokens, or acceptance URL is stored in this evidence record.
